title: ABEP upstream gas-chain interface control document (ICD) v1
description: JSON Schema for one upstream-state record crossing the ABEP gas-supply chain intake -> filter -> compressor -> atmospheric gas chamber -> valve -> thruster, and Xe chamber -> valve -> thruster (RFP architecture, CLAUDE.md 'Next work' 1, scope note). Each property of an interface is a quantity object (value, unit, evidence class, uncertainty). The 'x-field' annotation on each property records the code that produces and consumes it at this commit, its status (supplied / partial / derivable / gap), validity domain and uncertainty source. The explanation is docs/interfaces/UPSTREAM_ICD.md; tests/test_upstream_icd.py checks the references. This is an interface definition, not a physics model, a validation claim or an ABEP closure claim. 'Upstream' here means the gas-supply chain upstream of the thruster, not hallthruster_bridge/upstream/ (the HallThruster.jl project).

x-icd.name: upstream_icd
x-icd.versioning: semantic: removing or renaming a field, changing a unit or the species set = major; adding a field or an interface = minor; annotation/status/producer updates = patch. The instance's icd_version must equal this version.
x-icd.species_source: abep_sim/constants.py M_SPECIES (the atmospheric path carries O, N2, O2; the Xe path carries Xe)

status_values.supplied: an existing function/attribute returns the quantity (output_key, in the ICD unit or a stated native unit)
status_values.derivable: no function returns it, but it follows from supplied quantities by the stated derivation
status_values.partial: produced only on a non-production path, only in part, or under a stated simplifying assumption; 'requires' says what is missing
status_values.gap: no producer; 'requires' says what is needed (TBD)

variable_classes.mdot_s: species-resolved (and total) mass flow crossing the interface, incl. leak/recirculation branches
variable_classes.p: static pressure at the interface (total and partial), or the ratio that sets it
variable_classes.T: gas (and where relevant wall) temperature at the interface
variable_classes.x_s: composition: mole fraction x_s, mass fraction w_s, composition-changing wall chemistry
variable_classes.dmdot_dt: time derivative of the mass flow crossing the interface
variable_classes.inventory: gas mass held in the element upstream of the interface
variable_classes.residence_time: mean residence time (or wall-collision count) of gas in the upstream element
variable_classes.conductance: flow conductance / pumping speed / transmission probability of the upstream element
variable_classes.pressure_loss: static-pressure drop across the upstream element
variable_classes.shaft_power: mechanical shaft power (and the electrical input that drives it)
variable_classes.rejected_heat: heat the upstream element rejects to the thermal network
variable_classes.contamination: non-propellant loading: AO flux/fluence, erosion products, outgassing carried or accumulated
variable_classes.quality: state-quality flags: domain, convergence, feasibility, trust

units.kg s^-2: rate of change of mass flow

validity_domains.D-ATM-FROZEN: Frozen NRLMSIS 2.1 scenario dataset abep_sim/data/atmosphere_msis21_v1.{csv,json}: altitude 150-300 km, F10.7 = F10.7A in {70, 100, 150, 190, 230}, ap 15, orbit-averaged (atmosphere.ATM_VERSION: lat -60..60 x 4 LST sectors), epoch 2028-03-21T12:00. Outside the grid atmosphere() raises ValueError (_interp_frozen). Composition carried: O, N2, O2 only (He/H/Ar/N dropped, per the atmosphere.py code comment: verify). RFP operating envelope 180-230 km (constants.RFP alt_min_km/alt_max_km).
validity_domains.D-TPMC-FROZEN: Frozen TPMC response surface abep_sim/data/intake_surface_v1.{csv,json}: L/d {3,5,10,20}, phi {0.8,0.9}, alpha {0,0.2,0.5,0.8,1.0}, theta {0,2,5} deg, species O/N2/O2, scattering maxwell or cll, built at 200 km, F10.7 150. IntakeSurface.__call__ raises ValueError outside the grid (no extrapolation). The surface has no filter column: response_surface() builds IntakeGeometry without a filter.
validity_domains.D-TPMC-DIRECT: Direct TPMC (intake_tpmc.intake_response): free-molecular (Kn >> 1) honeycomb of circular channels, Maxwell or CLL wall scattering; converged when unresolved_fraction <= 1e-3. Not used on the production path (system.evaluate uses the frozen surface).
validity_domains.D-INTAKE-PARAM: Parametric intake/compressor (intake.IntakeParams/CompressorParams with use_tpmc=False): eta_c is a blend of two code priors times cos^2(off-axis); compress() uses a total number-density ratio. Code defaults, evidence class assumed.
validity_domains.D-DRAGCOMP: compressor.DragCompressor: free-molecular turbomolecular rows + Holweck/Gaede drag stages with a linear Gaede throughput characteristic, per-species K clipped to [1, K0]; rotor_ok requires tip speed <= u_max (materials DB yield / (stress_safety x density)); size_for() searches turbo rows 1-6, drag stages 0-4, rpm 5000..min(rpm_max, stress limit) in 2500 steps. No Knudsen-number check. Coefficients are code defaults.
validity_domains.D-RESERVOIR: reservoir.Reservoir: isothermal lumped volume, species O/O2/N2 only, molecular-flow orifice conductance K*A*c_bar/4, O wall recombination gamma(T) from the materials DB (literature-class priors per materials.py). size_orifice_for_pressure() bisects the anode-feed area in [1e-8, 3e-2] m^2. No Knudsen-number check.
validity_domains.D-SYSTEM-BUDGET: system.Budgets / system.evaluate parametric budget values (code defaults, evidence class assumed).
validity_domains.D-CARD: thruster.py card model (module docstring: every card number is a prior to be replaced by test data). Used by system.evaluate and transient.run_mission; not the HallThruster.jl path.
validity_domains.D-ARCH: archengine.gas_path_state -> archengine._propulsion hand-off (gas-path variables area and reservoir pressure are search variables of close_architecture).
validity_domains.D-AO: aochem.py / life.py / materials.py AO and erosion relations: literature-class priors (aochem.py and materials.py docstrings) to be replaced by coupon / AO-beam test data.
validity_domains.D-THERMAL: thermal.py lumped node network (default_nodes / solve_network / size_radiator); code defaults.
validity_domains.D-MISSION: transient.run_mission quasi-static time stepping (dt_h, default 1 h); no valve or line dynamics.
validity_domains.D-TBD: No producer, so no validity domain is defined. TBD with the producer.

closure_independence.rule: The thruster boundary (IF-A5, IF-X2) and every upstream interface are defined identically for every Hall transport closure. No field may name, depend on, or be produced by a transport closure, an ensemble member, or a layer-1 calibration-nuisance variable (P5 registration, coil shape, beam-efficiency reading, facility-ingestion interpretation). Calibration nuisance is marginalized when admitting closures and never leaks upstream into intake, filter, compressor, gas chambers or valves (CLAUDE.md Next work 1; abep_sim/hall_ensemble.py docstring). Hall maps are queried WITH the boundary state; they never write into it.

out_of_scope: intake drag and C_D (intake -> spacecraft/mission: intake.collection drag_N, C_D -> mission_env.spacecraft_drag)
thruster-side injector properties (neutral injection velocity; HallThruster.jl Propellant.velocity_m_s)
thruster electrical inputs (discharge voltage, magnet current) and all Hall outputs (hall_map_schema_v1)
facility background pressure (a ground-test facility interface, never a flight upstream field)

interfaces.description: one entry per interface present in this record (the Xe entries are absent in air-only operation)

evidence_class.description: quantity type of the value (docs/EVIDENCE.md). 'TBD' only when the value is null (no producer or not evaluated); a non-null value must carry one of the six classes

uncertainty.description: uncertainty of the value; kind 'TBD' when no uncertainty model exists (the usual case upstream today)
